subject: Exclusive Spring Sale Starts Today!
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to announce our exclusive Spring Sale, starting today! Enjoy up to 50% off on selected items in-store and online. Don't miss this opportunity to refresh your wardrobe for the new season. Visit our website or nearest store to discover the latest trends and amazing discounts. Hurry, as stocks are limited! Happy shopping! Best regards, The Spring Fashion Team
